items.q: What is the actual claim of '几十块就能买到的世界顶级产品'?
items.a: Not 'cheap is good.' **The category ceiling is often pocket money** because the process already scaled: Kai forging, Bic volume, Mitsubishi tip/ink, FRAKTA weave.

items.q: Which items in the list stay inside tens of yuan?
items.a: Kai clippers, Bic (¥2–3), YKK (as a part), Victorinox peeler, UHU, Band-Aid, Mitsubishi gel, FRAKTA (a few yuan), Zojirushi. **#1 does not.**

sections.title: The tell you did not buy

items.q: Why is YKK on the list if you never bought a zipper?
items.a: It is a **hidden-component tell**. '看一眼拉链上的YKK标志' grades the garment. You shopped the coat; the factory shopped the zipper.

items.q: What counts as evidence in this video?
items.a: A **named process plus a use test**: tomato-thin peel, drop the pen, overnight heat, splash-guard clippers. Not a lab. AI-zh captions also garble a few words.
Zwilling Solingen kitchen shears are **hundreds of yuan**, sold as a 传家宝. Bone, walnut, bottle cap. Read 9 cheap ceilings + 1 heirloom.

items.q: How is this different from ultra-fast-fashion cheapness?
items.a: Opposite stack. Here cheap means **scaled industrial default**. Fast-fashion cheap means daily trash. FRAKTA is the demo: few yuan, tens of 斤, handles hold.
